feedbackPlaceholder: Describe what looked wrong. Please avoid pasting meeting content - the technical detail is captured automatically.
formulasIntro: Saved prompts you can run over any recording from its Formulas tab.
formulasEmpty: No formulas yet. Create one to get started.
formulaStructuredHint: This formula uses a structured template, which can't be edited as a single prompt yet. Its name, description and context can still be changed.
formulaContextHint: Choose which parts of the recording this formula can see.
formulaSharedHint: Other people can find and add this formula. They can run it but not edit it, and your later changes apply to them too.
formulaSignalsHint: Choose which automation signals fire when this formula finishes running.
nativeLanguageHint: Used as the default language when translating a transcript.
appLanguageHint: The language the interface is shown in (where a translation is available).
calendarSelectionHint: Choose which Google calendars to consider when matching recordings to meetings. Only the selected calendars appear elsewhere in the app.
calendarsIntro: Everything that feeds the Calendar tab and matches recordings to meetings. Connect an account, mirror a desktop calendar, or subscribe to a feed.
calendarsGoogleMetaEmpty: Match recordings to your Google meetings
calendarsGoogleGrantPrompt: Diariz is signed in to this Google account but cannot read its calendar yet.
calendarsGoogleDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google Calendar? Diariz stops reading it and your calendar selection is forgotten.
calendarsOutlookMeta: Mirrored from classic Outlook on your Windows PC
calendarsFeedsMeta: Public team or shared calendars by URL, with or without an account
googleNotConnected: Not connected. Sign in with Google to link your account.
googleConnectError: Could not start the Google connection.
calFeedsIntro: Subscribe to external .ics calendar feeds (public team or shared calendars). Their events show on the Calendar tab in the colour you choose. Works with or without Google connected.
calFeedSaveError: Could not save the calendar feed.
calFeedRemoveError: Could not remove the calendar feed.
integrationsIntro: Ways other software reaches Diariz, and ways Diariz reaches out. Tokens are shown once when generated and never again.
integrationsMcpMeta: Read your meetings from Claude Desktop, Claude Code or claude.ai
integrationsApiMeta: Call the Diariz REST API as yourself from a script or another system
integrationsAutomationsMeta: Send meeting events out to Zapier, n8n, Make or any webhook
integrationsConnectedAppsHint: Signed in through Diariz to reach your meetings
integrationsApiDisabled: API access is switched off for this platform. Ask a Platform Administrator to enable it.
integrationsMcpDisabled: MCP access is switched off for this platform. Ask a Platform Administrator to enable it.
integrationsAutomationsDisabled: Automations are switched off for this platform. Ask a Platform Administrator to enable them.
automationHint: Paste the webhook URL your tool gives you - in Zapier it is the "Catch Hook" trigger, in n8n the Webhook node's Production URL.
automationTestError: Could not send a test event.
automationDeleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Diariz stops sending it events. This cannot be undone.
mcpIntro: Generate a token to connect Claude to your transcripts. Add the URL and token to Claude's MCP config; the token is shown only once.
mcpTokenOnce: Copy this token now - you won't be able to see it again.
mcpDesktopNote: Claude Desktop runs this through mcp-remote (needs Node.js installed). Claude Code can instead add the URL and token directly.
apiIntro: Generate a personal token to call the Diariz API as yourself. The token is shown once - store it securely.
apiTokenOnce: Copy this token now - it won't be shown again.
apiLoadError: The API reference couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
apiAccessEnabledHelp: Let users generate personal API tokens and call the Diariz API. Off by default.
mcpAccessEnabledHelp: Let users connect Claude to their meetings and mint MCP tokens.
webhooksEnabledHelp: Let users send their meeting events to tools like Zapier and n8n.
signalsIntro: Named triggers an author can attach to a formula. When the formula finishes, a platform automation wired to that signal receives its output.
signalKeyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores (e.g. action_item_created).
platformAutomationsHint: Define a Workflow Signal above, then add an automation here and tick the signals that route to it. When any user's formula tagged with one of those signals finishes, its output is delivered to this URL. An automation with no signal selected never fires.
platformAutomationSignals: Which signals should route to it?
platformAutomationNeedsSignal: Choose at least one signal - a platform automation with no signal never fires.
platformAiIntro: Platform-wide AI generation settings applied to every user.
placementHeading: Where a new recording is filed
placementUngroupedMeta: Everything lands in one place; file it into a folder afterwards.
placementSelectedMeta: Files into whichever folder is open in the list when you start recording.
placementSpecificMeta: Always the same folder, wherever you happen to be.
calendarAutoStopHeading: Let a calendar meeting end its own recording
calendarAutoStopBody: Only when you join the meeting from your calendar, so its end time is known. A recording you start with the Record button is not cut short by this option.
calendarStopMinutesSuffix: minutes after the meeting was due to finish,
calendarSilenceSuffix: seconds of silence - whichever comes first.
calendarAutoStopExample: A 10:00-11:00 meeting keeps recording until {{until}} - or stops sooner, once {{seconds}} seconds pass with nobody speaking.
autoMergeHeading: Merge each speaker's turn into one block
autoMergeBody: When a recording finishes transcribing, consecutive rows from the same person are joined automatically - the same thing the transcript's Merge button does, without the click. Notes and screenshots stay as boundaries. It is permanent for that transcript: to get short rows back, turn this off and transcribe it again.
calendarAfterMinutes: Minutes after the meeting was due to finish
aiIntro: Your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, used for both summaries and chat. Leave fields blank to use the server default.
keyWillClear: The stored key will be cleared on save.
chatToolsHint: Let the chat model call built-in tools that search your transcripts. Requires a model that supports tool calling.
assistantIntro: What the assistant is allowed to look up when it answers you. The model itself is chosen by your administrator.
assistantToolsMeta: Let chat look things up in your transcripts - needs a tool-calling model
toolPhrase_who_said_that: who said a phrase, and when
toolPhrase_what_did_they_say: what one person said on a topic
toolPhrase_list_recordings: meetings by date, name, speaker or topic
toolPhrase_when_was_discussed: first and last time a topic came up
toolPhrase_count_mentions: how often a term was said, by speaker
toolPhrase_send_email: send an answer to your own address
toolPhrase_get_transcript: the full text of one meeting
toolPhrase_get_recording_details: when it was, how long, who spoke
toolPhrase_get_segment_context: what was said either side of a moment
toolPhrase_run_formula: run one of your saved formulas
toolPhrase_add_as_attachment: save an answer onto a meeting
reasoningHint: Ask reasoning-capable models to think before answering (sends reasoning_effort). Leave off for models that don't support it.
timeoutHint: How long to wait for the model between chunks of a reply. Leave blank to use the platform default. Raise it for a large local model.
quotasIntro: New users start with the starter quota; administrators can raise a user up to the maximum.
autoDeleteAudioHint: A nightly job deletes the audio of recordings older than the retention window (transcripts are kept). Protected recordings are never touched.
retentionDaysInvalid: The retention window must be a whole number of days (at least 1).
runAudioRetentionConfirm: Delete the audio of all recordings older than {{days}} days now? Protected recordings are kept. This cannot be undone.
feedbackIntro: Submissions from the Provide Feedback dialog, newest first. Each includes the route, app release and a scrubbed trail of what the user was doing just before they reported it.
feedbackEmpty: No feedback has been submitted yet.
feedbackTrailEmpty: No trail was captured for this submission.
backupDescription: Download the entire platform - the database and all stored files - as a single archive you can keep or move to another machine.
backupSensitive: The backup contains all platform data (including password hashes and every recording). Store it securely.
backupPreparing: You can leave this page open - the download starts on its own once the archive is ready.
backupCopyingDatabase: Preparing your backup: copying the database - {{elapsed}}
backupArchivingFiles: Preparing your backup: archiving files ({{files}} so far) - {{elapsed}}
backupReady: Backup ready - check your browser's downloads.
tagBackfillDescription: Queue tag extraction for every recording that has never been tagged (for example, recordings made before the tag cloud existed, or whose owner had no AI model configured). Tags appear as the jobs complete.
runTagBackfillConfirm: Queue tag extraction for every recording without tags? Each recording is processed with its owner's AI model settings.
restoreDescription: Replace this platform's data with the contents of a backup archive. Only a backup from this app version can be restored.
restoreDanger: This permanently replaces ALL data - every user, recording and setting. The app is briefly unavailable and you will be signed out.
restoreConfirm: I understand this will permanently replace all current data.
restoreApplying: Upload complete. The server is applying the backup - {{elapsed}}. This can take several minutes; keep this window open.
restoreMigrated: Restored an older backup and upgraded its data to the current version ({{from}} to {{to}}).
restoreRestartHint: Restart the app to finish applying the upgrade.
minutesModeHint: Platform-wide: how meeting minutes are generated from a template. Applies from the next run.
llmTimeoutHint: Platform-wide request timeout for every AI call (summaries, minutes, actions, tags, embeddings). Raise it for slow local models. Default 120.
llmTimeoutInvalid: The LLM timeout must be a whole number of seconds (at least 5).
llmUsageLoggingHint: Record every LLM call (tokens, latency, model, outcome) for auditing and cost tracking.
llmUsageRetentionHint: How long usage log rows are kept before the nightly sweep deletes them. 0 keeps everything.
llmUsageRetentionInvalid: The usage log retention window must be a whole number of days (0 or more).
llmStreamUsageLabel: Request token counts on streaming calls
llmStreamUsageHint: Ask the endpoint for token counts on streamed responses, when it supports it. Turn this off if your endpoint rejects the request.
llmUsageForbidden: You don't have permission to view the LLM usage log. This is limited to Platform Administrators.
llmUsageLoadError: The usage log couldn't be loaded.
llmUsageFiltersLoadError: The user/type/model filter options couldn't be loaded - the filters below may be incomplete.
llmUsageFilterNoOptions: No values in this date range.
llmUsageDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{count}} usage log rows matching the current filters? This cannot be undone.
llmUsageDeleteError: The usage log rows couldn't be deleted.
llmUsageSummaryLoadError: The usage summary couldn't be loaded.
automationsIntro: Send your meeting events to tools like Zapier, n8n, or Make. Pick what should trigger, paste the URL from your tool, and test it.
automationIncludeContactsHint: Sends each attendee's email address and phone number to this URL, alongside their name, job title and company. Leave it off unless the destination needs to contact people.
automationSecretOnce: Signing secret (shown once) - optional, use it to verify requests really came from Diariz.
automationTokenOffer: This automation may need to read results back into your workflow. Create a read-only access token?
platformAutomationIncludeFeedbackTextHin: The description is free text and may quote meeting content, so it is only sent when you ask for it. With this off the automation still gets who sent it, the page they were on and the release.
outlookIntro: Mirror the calendar from classic Outlook on your Windows PC, so those meetings behave like any other - shown on the Calendar tab, matched to your recordings, and carrying pre-meeting notes.
outlookPrivacyNote: Meeting titles, times, locations, attendees and invite text are stored on this server so they still work in a browser and when the desktop app is closed. Private appointments are skipped by default. Turning this off deletes everything already stored.
outlookOptOutConfirm: Turn off Outlook sync? Every machine is disconnected and all the meetings copied from them are deleted from this server.
outlookRequiresDesktop: Syncing runs from the Diariz desktop app on Windows. You can manage everything here from any browser.
outlookErrNotAvailable: This app cannot reach Outlook on this PC. Diariz needs classic Outlook for Windows - the new Outlook does not let other apps read your calendar.
outlookErrCooldown: That machine synced a moment ago. Try again shortly.
outlookErrStillNotFound: Classic Outlook still was not found on this PC.
outlookNoDevices: No machines connected yet. Open Diariz on a Windows PC with Outlook to connect one.
outlookRemoveConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? Every meeting copied from it is deleted from this server.
llmModelsForbidden: You don't have permission to manage AI models. This is limited to Platform Administrators.
llmModelsIntro: Every AI call the platform makes is routed to one of these models. Parameters are set per model, and can be overridden per call type.
llmModelsAddAllTitle: Add all models from an endpoint
llmModelsAddAllIntro: Ask a server what models it has, then pick which to add. Non-chat models such as embeddings and speech recognition are left out.
llmModelsDiscoverEmpty: No models were found at that endpoint.
llmModelsCtxNotReported: context length not reported - check it
llmModelsLoadError: The models could not be loaded.
llmModelsEmpty: No models are configured. The endpoint from the server environment is used until you add one.
llmModelsDeleteError: The model could not be deleted.
llmModelsImportError: The environment model could not be imported.
llmModelsAssignError: The assignments could not be saved.
llmModelsInChatAria: Offer {{model}} in the chat model picker
llmModelsInChatLocked: The chat model is always offered in the picker.
llmModelsDisplayNameHint: Shown to users in the chat model picker. Leave blank to use the model name.
llmModelsRoutingFooter: One dot per column - each call type runs on exactly one model. Chat also offers every model ticked under In chat.
llmModelsNoModelHint: Call types follow the default. The default falls back to the server environment.
llmModelsNameHint: Sent verbatim as the model in each request.
llmModelsCopyFromHint: Parameters only - the connection details above are left alone.
llmModelsSaveError: The model could not be saved.
llmModelsDiscardConfirm: Discard the unsaved changes to this model?
llmParamBaseHint: These apply to every call type unless a tab below overrides them.
llmParamGroupHint: {{group}} starts from Defaults - change only what should differ.
llmTestWaiting: Streaming - waiting for the first token...
llmTestFixTimeoutHint: This call inherits Timeout {{seconds}} from Defaults, but the model may still be loading.
llmTestFixOmitHint: Set {{parameter}} to omitted and it stops being sent - for this call type only.
llmTestSaveFirst: Save the model before running a test.
llmTestClientFlags: Timeout {{timeout}}s · tools {{tools}} · images {{images}}. Not sent to the model.
llmParamReasoningEffortHint: Free text - whatever this model accepts (low, medium, high, xhigh...)
llmUsageTruncatedHint: The model hit its token cap before finishing. The reply may be short or completely empty, even though the call succeeded and the tokens were billed.
transcriptionLanguageHint: The language your recordings are usually spoken in. Detecting it per recording can go wrong on a quiet opening. Each recording can still override this.
